newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: UNHCR to evacuate staff from Sierra Leone.
newsitem.headline: UNHCR to evacuate staff from Sierra Leone.

text.p: The United Nations refugee agency said it would evacuate most of its staff from Sierra Leone on Tuesday following Sunday's military coup.

A UNHCR spokeswoman said the Geneva-based agency would leave a skeleton staff of five out of 26 now in the former British colony in West Africa where an army major ousted the elected government of president Ahmad Tejan Kabbah in a weekend coup.
The coup forced the Geneva-based International Committee of the Red Cross (ICRC) to suspend its operations in Sierra Leone at the weekend.
The new military rulers in the capital Freetown promised on Tuesday to cooperate with any evacuation of foreigners. Western powers have condemned the coup and urged a return to civilian rule.

Reports said Freetown was calmer on Tuesday following sporadic gunfire and looting that erupted on Sunday. Looters have taken some 1,650 tonnes of U.N. food aid and vehicles and other equipment belonging to U.N. agencies in the city.
